commentary_title: Softness prevails in the Aframax market
commentary_summary: It was a slow week for the Aframax market as the tonne-miles index continued to weaken, but remained stable compared to previous weeks. Due to the softness in tonnage demand in recent weeks, vessel utilisation also fell, accompanied by declining vessel speeds. | Towards the Med, there was low tonnage demand causing more tonnage to accumulate at the ports. The UKC region fared better in comparison, which could see more vessels ballasting towards the UKC next week.
